hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize permission bit set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op (returns the selector only). Liquidity bootstrapping and initial tick recording are performed via a separate initializePools() call that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap, liquidity, or donate hooks are active.
